_notes: Reviewed all 469 keys against current English; no null cur in this job. 134 patched, the rest kept.

Current English splits sentences with periods; the success/writing/concierge strings still carried the old em-dash joins. Rewritten as separate sentences to match EN and the rest of the id student copy.

'Tim Hangyul Univ' normalized to 'tim Hangyul' to match EN 'the Hangyul team' (dashboard.counselor.team keeps 'Tim Hangyul Univ', as EN does). The id locale outside this job is still split (~79 'Hangyul Univ' vs ~37 'Hangyul'); owner to confirm the house form.
Standard admission letter = 'surat penerimaan standar' (applicationDetail ADMISSION_CERTIFICATE_ISSUED). Stage VISA_PREPARATION = 'Menyiapkan dokumen visa Anda' (glossary: visa document preparation).

'Terverifikasi' kept where it means data read from an official source (visaroute NO_ROUTE/OTHER_RESIDENCE, submission.partial/placeholder, mobile dataUnverified, legalFlow UNVERIFIED); changed to 'diperiksa' only for the team's document check (DOCUMENT_PREPARATION).
'Konselor Anda' kept wherever current EN still says 'your counselor' (visaroute, writing, concierge); 'tim Hangyul' where EN says the Hangyul team.
phase.discover.label 'Temukan' -> 'Jelajahi' (EN 'Explore'); owner may want the same in any other journey-stage label outside this job.
v9.sponsor.foot: removed the extra sentence ('Semua keputusan dibuat oleh universitas dan kedutaan.') that current EN does not have.
